installSteps: Copy cyclorama-dawn.toml, cyclorama-steel.toml, and cyclorama-day.toml into ~/.config/wezterm/colors/ (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.config\wezterm\colors\).
Set config.color_scheme = "Cyclorama Dawn" (or "Cyclorama Steel" / "Cyclorama Day") in your wezterm.lua.
author: Real-Fruit-Snacks

themes.name: Cyclorama Dawn
themes.tagline: Matte #050507 dark stage with Beacon Orange focus and Steel Blue secondary accents.
themes.copySnippet:
# Cyclorama Dawn (LX 263 Dark · Beacon Orange) — WezTerm Color Scheme
# Brand: Cyclorama Dawn v2.3.2 | Author: Real-Fruit-Snacks

[metadata]
name = "Cyclorama Dawn"
author = "Real-Fruit-Snacks"
origin_url = "https://github.com/Real-Fruit-Snacks/rfs-themes"

[colors]
foreground = "#F4F5F8"
background = "#050507"
cursor_bg = "#F06E2B"
cursor_fg = "#050507"
cursor_border = "#F06E2B"
selection_fg = "#F4F5F8"
selection_bg = "#3D2B24"
scrollbar_thumb = "#62646D"
split = "#2A2C35"
ansi = ["#0C0C10", "#FF5C6C", "#3DDC97", "#FFC247", "#74B8E8", "#C996F5", "#56D4E0", "#D6D8E0"]
brights = ["#8C8F9D", "#FF9254", "#6CE8B2", "#FFD475", "#99CDF2", "#DCB8FA", "#85E3EC", "#F4F5F8"]

[colors.tab_bar]
background = "#070709"
inactive_tab_edge = "#2A2C35"

[colors.tab_bar.active_tab]
bg_color = "#BD4811"
fg_color = "#FFFFFF"
intensity = "Bold"
underline = "None"
italic = false
strikethrough = false

[colors.tab_bar.inactive_tab]
bg_color = "#0C0C10"
fg_color = "#B3B5C0"

[colors.tab_bar.inactive_tab_hover]
bg_color = "#14141A"
fg_color = "#F4F5F8"
italic = false

[colors.tab_bar.new_tab]
bg_color = "#070709"
fg_color = "#B3B5C0"

[colors.tab_bar.new_tab_hover]
bg_color = "#14141A"
fg_color = "#FF9254"
italic = false
